Leave amount 0 / type 'included' where unknown. placeholder:true shows a 'placeholder' badge (can be hidden in Settings).

glass.name: Low-E / SunCoat
glass.desc: Microscopically thin coating on the glass reflects heat in summer and helps keep warmth in during winter. Cuts glare and UV fading of floors and furniture.

glass.name: Cardinal 340+
glass.desc: Upgraded multi-layer Low-E glass with stronger solar-heat control for hot, sunny exposures (west and south facing windows).

glass.name: Argon Gas Fill
glass.desc: Inert gas between the panes that slows heat transfer better than plain air, improving insulation and comfort.

glass.name: Tempered (Safety) Glass
glass.desc: Heat-strengthened safety glass that breaks into small pieces. Often required near doors, tubs and showers, and low to the floor.

glass.name: Obscure / Privacy Glass
glass.desc: Textured or frosted glass that lets light in but blocks the view. Popular for bathrooms and entries.

frame.name: Grids (Colonial)
frame.desc: Decorative divided-lite grid pattern between the glass for a traditional look.

frame.name: Grids (Prairie)
frame.desc: Prairie-style grid pattern around the perimeter of the sash.

frame.name: Retrofit / Flush-fin Install
frame.desc: Frame style that installs inside the existing opening without disturbing stucco or siding.

series.name: V300 Vinyl
bullets: Step-up construction and features over V250

series.name: V400 Vinyl
bullets: Our most popular upgrade for long-term homeowners
